title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator readiness — Batch 24: Lesotho

administrative_geography.lower_levels: Constituencies and community councils are lower levels. Four agro-ecological zones (Lowlands, Foothills, Mountains, Senqu River Valley) are separate analytical zones.

key_findings: Lesotho's ten first-level administrative districts are confirmed by Government and Bureau of Statistics sources. The region lookup now contains these ten districts.

The official 2022/23 Agricultural Production Survey provides district-level crop statistics for five major crops. National maize production was 126,994 tonnes from 149,271 harvested hectares (derived yield 0.851 t/ha); sorghum 9,088 tonnes from 16,965 ha (0.536 t/ha); wheat 6,251 tonnes from 10,639 ha (0.588 t/ha); beans 5,251 tonnes from 19,827 ha (0.265 t/ha); peas 357 tonnes from 953 ha (0.375 t/ha). These are historical 2022/23 observations, not current 2026 assumptions.

The same 2022/23 survey records national expenditure on inorganic fertilizer, organic fertilizer, seeds, pesticides, ploughing, weeding and harvesting. These are national mixed-crop expenditure totals, not current crop-specific per-hectare budgets.

FEWS NET's September 2026 update reports the Bureau of Statistics estimate that 2026 maize production was 30% below the previous year and 55% below the five-year average. Harvests were below average in the Mountains, Senqu River Valley and Southern Lowlands, and average elsewhere.

The September 2026 FEWS NET update reports the Government's 2026/27 Input Support Programme subsidy rates as 70% for seed and 80% for fertilizer. These are programme rates, not verified farmer co-payments or universal prices; eligibility, product mix, quantities and district availability remain to be checked.
WFP-derived August 2026 retail prices cover six food products across ten district markets. Maize meal, flour and packaged beans are consumer prices and cannot be used as raw-crop farmgate prices.
Lesotho's agricultural year runs from 1 August to 31 July, with summer/main and winter/off-season crops. Four agro-ecological zones must not be confused with the ten administrative districts.
safeguards: No existing active country profile or calculator formula was changed.
The ten official administrative districts were added only to the separate region lookup.
Historical 2022/23 crop observations were not represented as current 2026 yields.
2026/27 subsidy percentages were not converted into farmer-paid prices.
Retail WFP market prices were not relabelled as farmgate prices.
No merge or production deployment was performed.
next_step: Extract and reconcile the complete 2025/26 crop forecasting report by district and crop; verify actual farmer co-payments under the 2026/27 input support programme; obtain dated district farmgate prices and crop-specific input/enterprise budgets.
